### Executive Summary

Fintech company Revolut has confirmed a customer data breach occurring shortly before its planned launch in Israel. The breach allowed unauthorized access to customer information through the submission of fraudulent government requests. 

Detailed information regarding the total number of affected users and the specific region of impact remains not yet confirmed. Cyberpent is continuing to monitor the situation for further official disclosures.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause

The root cause of the security breach involves threat actors submitting fake government requests to trick internal processes into granting access to customer data. 

The full technical impact, including the specific types of data compromised and the precise mechanisms used to authenticate the fraudulent requests, has not yet been confirmed by the organization.

### Mitigation & IOCs

Specific technical mitigations associated with this incident have not been provided in the source material. Organizations processing sensitive data are advised to review and enforce strict authentication processes for law enforcement and government data requests.
